verdict.rationale: Bolt offers project versioning through GitHub: automatic commit sync, branches and a full change history kept outside Bolt. It can read and create pull requests via GitHub, and Plan Mode lets you discuss changes without applying them. A community user also describes reverting bad AI output, which shows a rollback path exists. This covers Bolt projects as a whole, not automations specifically: there is no evidence of versioning or rollback for Skills or saved prompts, and no first-party rollback doc. Missing for 10: versioning/history for automation artifacts (skills, prompts), documented native rollback/restore, an in-product diff/review flow for AI changes, independent hands-on corroboration.
